description:
Make archive execute read prior executions from the target's evidence record, once, instead of parsing the event log twice.

## Background

Execute captures the whole event log (`capture_archive_base`, `crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:343`) and parses it twice from the image: in the planner (`commands/archive.rs:713`) and in the finalizer (`repository_state/archive.rs:31`), both through `captured_archive_events` (`repository_state/archive.rs:456-466`, `pub(crate)`, re-exported at `repository_state/mod.rs:27`), which fails as `ArchiveExecutionError::EventLog`. Each target's executions are now in `archive-evidence/<target-key>.json`, which execute captures.

Kept as one change for a build reason: the planner and the finalizer are the only callers of `captured_archive_events`, and unused crate-private code fails the zero-warning build, so the function, its re-export and the error variant it alone produces go with them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Execute reads the target's evidence record once from its image, the finalizer receives it from the planner, and the archive base captures the event log as a tail.
- [hard] REQ-02: `captured_archive_events`, its re-export and `ArchiveExecutionError::EventLog` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-03: A test shows that execute of a re-archived target succeeds with an unparseable event log and produces the same coverage and residue identities as before.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Archive execute reads the per-target evidence record
